Working an 8 to 4 job for the rest of my life sounds boring. What are some jobs or lifestyles that allow you to freelance, and/or travel?
Many if not most consultants have this kind of "freedom" at the usual cost of classical job security and certain other benefits.

If you're a good writer, you could become a travel blogger. You'd be surprised. It might take a little time, but once you get a consistent viewership, companies will start sponsoring your travels and pay for most, if not, all of the associated expenses, and it pretty much takes off from there.

Another job that allows for freedom is programming. There are a plethora of free resources on the web to learn a number of programming languages and platforms. Once you develop some skill, you can start selling your work to people/companies and help them build websites, apps, etc. Obviously this can be done from anywhere that has access to a computer and the internet.

I would say your best bets are freelance writing or programming work, as you have more independence considering you're not attached to a specific company (you are your own boss), and you're only really limited by the availability of internet access.
